title: Whose is it?
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y8 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: whose is it?)
intro: Lesson 36: Attached pronouns: بَيْتِي، بَيْتُكَ، بَيْتُهُ، بَيْتُهَا. To understand how attached pronouns show possession on nouns, including words ending in ة

questions.model: Teacher: مَطْبَخ + ـُهُ = مَطْبَخُهُ. حَدِيقَة: ة becomes ت, + ـُنَا = حَدِيقَتُنَا.

questions.q: Whose is it? On the pupil PDF, rewrite ten phrases with endings (for example غُرْفَة + my = غُرْفَتِي), then write four sentences about rooms in your home and whose they are. Start: هٰذِهِ غُرْفَتِي ...
questions.a: Ten correct forms with ة → ت where needed; four correct sentences
questions.model: Teacher does: سَرِير + his = سَرِيرُهُ; سَيَّارَة + our = سَيَّارَتُنَا.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: what else joins together in Arabic?
questions.a: Letters in writing; pronouns on nouns and verbs
